似乎是华山派的哑仆.en: Geb greets visitors to Thoth's retreat with a wave and a watchful eye.
似乎是华山派的哑仆.zh-CN: 盖布挥手迎接来访者，留意着通往托特居所的小路。

text.en: Does every teacher live at the top of a mountain?
text.zh-CN: 所有老师都住在山顶上吗？

text.en: Only the ones hoping to avoid visitors. I've been thinking about our next move.
text.zh-CN: 只有那些不想被打扰的。我一直在想，咱们接下来该怎么办。

text.en: Before I return to camp, I want you to meet Thoth. He taught me, and he may agree to teach you.
text.zh-CN: 回营地之前，我想带你见见托特。他教过我，也许也愿意教你。

text.en: You're leaving?
text.zh-CN: 你要走了？

text.en: I've healed enough to return to my duties. You still have a great deal to learn.
text.zh-CN: 我的伤已经好得差不多，该回去做事了。你还有很多本领要学。

text.en: Then let me come with you.
text.zh-CN: 那让我跟你一起去。

text.en: Not yet. Learn to stand your ground before you go looking for trouble.
text.zh-CN: 还不行。先学会站稳脚跟，再去找麻烦。

text.en: (Geb raises a hand in greeting, then points to the narrow trail.)
text.zh-CN: （盖布举手招呼，随后指向狭窄的小路。）

text.en: Geb. Good to see you. Horus, he keeps Thoth's visitors from wandering off a cliff.
text.zh-CN: 盖布，见到你真好。荷鲁斯，多亏有他照看，来拜访托特的人才不会走下悬崖。

text.en: Good to meet you. I was beginning to worry about that.
text.zh-CN: 很高兴见到你。我刚才还真在担心这个。

text.en: (Geb smiles and beckons you along the path.)
text.zh-CN: （盖布笑着招手，示意你们沿小路跟上。）

text.en: (Geb taps on the door and gestures for you to enter.)
text.zh-CN: （盖布轻敲房门，示意你们进去。）

text.en: Visitors? I was just enjoying a remarkably quiet day.
text.zh-CN: 有客人？我正享受这难得安静的一天呢。

text.en: Master Thoth! I've come to be your student.
text.zh-CN: 托特大师！我是来拜师的。

text.en: You have the introduction backward. Usually, I agree first.
text.zh-CN: 你把顺序弄反了。通常，得先问问我同不同意。

text.en: I've taught Horus a few Gauntlet techniques. He learns quickly, especially when he listens. Will you give him a chance?
text.zh-CN: 我教过荷鲁斯几招拳套战技。他学得很快，尤其是肯认真听的时候。能给他一个机会吗？

text.en: I'll judge that for myself. Show me what you've learned.
text.zh-CN: 这个，我亲自判断。让我看看你学到了什么。

text.en: A quick learner. Yes, I'll teach you. We can work on the listening.
text.zh-CN: 学得确实快。好，我愿意教你。认真听讲的本领，可以慢慢练。

text.en: Thank you, Thoth.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你，托特。

text.en: Thank you, teacher!
text.zh-CN: 谢谢老师！

text.en: (Horus bows so low that he nearly loses his balance.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯深深鞠躬，差点没站稳。）

text.en: Stay here and learn, Horus. I'll see our friend back down the mountain.
text.zh-CN: 留在这里好好学，荷鲁斯。我陪咱们的朋友下山。

text.en: Thank you, Shu. For bringing me here. For all of it.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你，舒。谢谢你带我来，还有一路上的一切。

text.en: Save some gratitude for after your first lesson.
text.zh-CN: 留点谢意，等上完第一堂课再说。

text.en: Thank you, my friend. I'll stay here and train. Perhaps we'll share the road again.
text.zh-CN: 也谢谢你，朋友。我会留下练习，也许以后还能再次同行。

text.en: Take your time. I'd prefer a reunion with fewer rescue attempts.
text.zh-CN: 慢慢学。下次重逢，我希望能少救你几回。

text.en: A gift for the road. Three Orchardkeeper's Peaches. You've earned more than sore feet.
text.zh-CN: 送你三颗守园人的蜜桃，带在路上。这一路，你不该只收获两只酸疼的脚。

text.en: Thank you. Finally, a lesson I can eat.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢。终于有一堂课，能吃进肚子里了。

text.en: Rough around the edges, but you've only just begun. I'll teach you.
text.zh-CN: 还不够熟练，不过你也才刚开始。我愿意教你。

text.en: Thank you, Thoth.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你，托特。

text.en: Thank you, teacher!
text.zh-CN: 谢谢老师！

text.en: (Horus bows, then winces at a fresh bruise.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯鞠了一躬，牵动新添的淤青，忍不住咧了咧嘴。）

text.en: Stay and learn, Horus. If you mean to help people, start by keeping your guard up.
text.zh-CN: 留下来学吧，荷鲁斯。真想帮助别人，就先学会保护好自己。

text.en: I will. I won't waste this chance.
text.zh-CN: 我会的。我不会浪费这个机会。

text.en: Good. I'm returning to camp. Take care of each other.
text.zh-CN: 好。我要回营地了，你们互相照顾。

text.en: We will. Safe travels, Shu.
text.zh-CN: 我们会的。舒，一路平安。
